text_block_list.text:
Upon passing a park on my way home from a 
movie, I notice Neo Universe standing 
there.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
…CONT… All received. Neo Universe is… 
Pleased.

I'm not quite sure what she's doing, but 
it's less than an hour until the dorm's 
curfew starts, so I call out to her.
choice_data_list:
<size=38>Don't mean to interrupt, but curfew's 
soon.</size>

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I only want to… Communicate a little 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Etheric Particles have… weakened 
attenuation. The voice coming from the 
Singularity can be heard clearly now.

I recognize these terms as astrophysical 
ones and conclude from the situation that 
she must be "communicating" with some 
space entity.
choice_data_list: I see. You really like space, don't you?
I see. You really like space, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is IRST… Do you… also Like 
space?

She seems to have noticed the small movie 
pamphlet I was still holding. It was about 
the space exploration movie I just 
watched. My mind half distracted by this, 
I said…
choice_data_list:
<size=38>Setting off into outer space is so 
enthralling!</size>

<size=38>Setting off into outer space is so 
enthralling!</size>

I love the idea of cooperating with 
aliens.

text_block_list.text:
A whole other world, still unexplored and 
unknown. An endless universe and exciting 
new encounters. It's such an appealing 
concept.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: …Do you want to feel… their presence?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Close… your eyes.

That's exactly what had happened in the 
movie. Anything is possible as long as you 
reach out to one another, even if not 
through words.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
You could convey those feelings… right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Close… your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Connect… Send a "Hello, hello" from the 
heart.

Upon speaking those words, a sound not 
unlike a bell's rung in my head.

Though my eyes were closed, an incredible 
scene unfolded in front of me.
choice_data_list: O-Outer space!? How? I was in a park…!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This… is the gateway to Observation. Neo 
Universe provided NAV. Do not fear.

I floated through space, unable to discern 
any words in the voice-like noises 
streaming through my head.
choice_data_list: B-But I'm uh, hearing strange voices…

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
FELT… Meaning can be conveyed… without 
words. The same is true… for your own 
thoughts.

It was a strange sensation. Even though I 
couldn't understand anything, I definitely 
felt something akin to friendship, just 
like she said.

Conversing without the boundaries of 
words… It was like being in one of those 
science fiction movies for a bit.

With the removal of her finger from my 
forehead, I returned to a normal state of 
consciousness. Before me laid not outer 
space, but the park we were in.
choice_data_list: Was that… some kind of dream…?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: LMT… Let's go back together.

It was real close to curfew now. I headed 
back to the Academy with Neo Universe, who 
appeared rather cheerful, in a slight 
panic.
